title: base_url path error message shows what is wrong but not what to do
description: client.rs JmapClient::new (lines 115-118): error message is 'base_url must not have a path component, got: "/jmap"'. User knows what they provided but not what the correct form is. A new user passing the full JMAP API URL (e.g. https://host/jmap/api) will not know from this message that base_url must be the server origin only. Suggested fix: append 'pass the server origin only, e.g. "https://host" or "https://host:8080"' to the message.
